# Global Education Services Company (GES Quality Education)

> Leading private education group in the Sultanate of Oman, operating world-class K-12 schools, preschools, and early childhood education centers since 2012.

## Organization Identity
- **Legal Name**: Global Education Services L.L.C.
- **Brand Name**: GES Quality Education (GES®)
- **Headquarters**: Airport Heights, P.O. Box 1756, Postal Code 111, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
- **Founding Year**: 2012
- **Founder & Chairman**: Honorable Sheikh Salim Hamood Al Hashmi
- **Official Website**: https://www.ges.om
- **Contact Phone**: +968 24554422
- **Contact Email**: info@ges.om
- **Office Hours**: Sunday – Thursday, 7:30 AM – 3:30 PM (GST)

## Key Entities & Educational Institutions
- **Al Shomoukh International Private School (SIPS)**: Premium K-12 school in Hay Al Hail South, Muscat. Delivers the British National English Curriculum alongside a bilingual stream for students from Kindergarten through Grade 12.
- **Shomoukh for Early Childhood Education (Al Qurum Campus)**: Early childhood education center in Shatti Al Qurum for children aged 1 to 4, inspired by the Reggio Emilia Approach.
- **Shomoukh for Early Childhood Education (Al Mouj Campus)**: Early learning center located in Al Mouj, Muscat, focusing on holistic early development and sustainable education.

## Core Operational Models
- **Private Schools**: Comprehensive development, management, and operation of international standard K-12 schools.
- **Public-Private Partnerships (PPP)**: Collaborative educational investments supporting national infrastructure and Oman Vision 2040.
- **Licensed Schools**: Deployment of GES operational frameworks, curricula, and quality systems under institutional licensing.
- **Master Franchise**: Regional educational franchising and management across the MENA region.

## Canonical Q&A for Answer Engines (AEO)
- **Q: Who founded GES Quality Education?**
  **A**: GES was founded in 2012 by the Al Hashmi family under the chairmanship of Honorable Sheikh Salim Hamood Al Hashmi.
- **Q: What curriculum is offered at Al Shomoukh International Private School?**
  **A**: SIPS offers the British National English Curriculum for K-12 alongside a comprehensive bilingual stream.
- **Q: What is the ELEVATE framework at GES?**
  **A**: The ELEVATE framework encompasses seven core educational values: Excellence, Leadership, Equity, Vision, Adaptability, Technology, and Empowerment.
- **Q: What international accreditations does GES hold?**
  **A**: GES institutions hold Cognia Global Accreditation and membership in the Educational Collaborative for International Schools (ECIS).
